top_concerns: Only one weak linear-head baseline and loss curves support the claim that the neural field is the key ingredient; no matched-FLOPs alternative decoders or FID-vs-step comparison

Uses REPA/DINOv2 alignment with no ablation, undermining the 'VAE-free, simple, end-to-end' framing; comparisons to latent models are not budget- or sampler-matched and still trail them (e.g. REPA 1.42, DDT 1.26)
Efficiency table has inconsistent numbers (0.010s per step vs 0.51s per image), higher training memory is undiscussed, and baselines are measured under unclear settings
Text-to-image evaluation weak: few old baselines, unusually high GenEval Position score, possible SFT-data overlap, no quantitative arbitrary-resolution or patch-boundary analysis
Writing and reproducibility issues: 'abc steps' placeholder, 0.82 vs 80.9 DPG, 0.73 vs 73.0, equation/notation errors, underspecified DCT encoding, single-run FIDs
